facts.fact: Lesotho News Agency reports that 23 of 30 cash pay-points for the elderly pension grant in Quthing district have closed after more than 4,800 beneficiaries were enrolled on mobile money (M-Pesa and EcoCash) since September 2024, with over 1,000 still paid in cash.
facts.system: mobile money pension payment (Mpesa and Eco-cash)
